body.value: One row, one figure: 57 is how many shops Contoso trades from today — physical premises with a place behind them and no closing date against them. It does NOT include the 16 premises that have stopped trading (9 'Closed', 7 'Restructured') and does NOT include the one web-shop row, which has no place, no country and no floor area. Counted over premises, which on this population equals places — the 57 rows sit on 57 distinct location codes — and over no period, because a store's existence is a standing fact on this dimension rather than something measured in a window.
